dogecoin.text: To be fair, crypto is broadly rising (Bitcoin, Etherium, Litecoin, etc), but Dogecoin is pacing the masses. Perhaps Cuban has finally taken the market influence title from Musk https://t.co/nfjApyXNTT
After another 48% rally this past session, Dogecoin ($DOGEUSD) is now up approximately 3,000% on the year. Makes Bitcoin's 118% climb in 2021 look like a pittance... https://t.co/jiczkmt6WT

Bitcoin has started to stabilize and pull back post-election, but Dogecoin is still exhibiting the extremes. 

$DOGEUSD is extremely volatile still today with the 3-day ATR at an eye-watering 33%: https://t.co/Cdcu5uL8eE

The Dogecoin 'mascot' premium - from Trump winning the election and a cheeky Elon using the same name for the cost-cutting department - has all but evaporated. 

$DOGEUSD peaked just over 200% above the pre-election results close in December, and all given back: https://t.co/tp8I4uS2Ap
